title: Sigeumchi Namul
description: Blanched spinach squeezed dry and dressed with garlic, soy, and toasted sesame. The simplest banchan and one of the most eaten.
notes: Keeps three days in the fridge. The same dressing works on bean sprouts.

steps.text: Blanch the spinach in boiling salted water for thirty seconds, then refresh in cold water.
steps.tip: Thirty seconds, no more. The leaves should still be vivid.

steps.text: Squeeze out as much water as you can, a handful at a time, then cut into 5 cm lengths.
Toss with the garlic, soy sauce, sesame oil, green onion, and sesame seeds, loosening the clumps with your fingers. Taste and adjust the salt.
